title: lonicera caerulea subsp. hirsuta
intro: Lonicera caerulea subsp. hirsuta, commonly known as the hairy honeysuckle or blue honeysuckle, is a plant species belonging to the Lonicera genus of flowering plants. The hairy honeysuckle is valued for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Lonicera caerulea subsp. hirsuta include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including respiratory issues and fever, with its bioactive constituents contributing to these effects. The bioactive constituents of the hairy honeysuckle plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, among other compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
